I loved having my boy at Amordw Estimativa.
I give top marks for bathing and grooming, and for the experience I had leaving him at the hotel.
And the girl Carolina is incredibly friendly.
Congratulations to the whole team.
Wonderful, I leave my pet with my eyes closed.

Their dedication to Farrusco was excellent. I recommend them.
Until next time.

My cat-sitting experience couldn't have been better. It was the first time I hired this type of service, and my kitten fell in love with the team from day one, and I felt 100% safe and comfortable <3 Now Carolina is my Pascoal's favorite aunt! 🐱

I highly recommend them and I'm now a regular customer.

Amidst so many options these days, it's difficult to find a place that inspires confidence regarding our furry friends, especially with so many atrocities happening. Amor de Estimação is managed by, and staffed by, people who completely exceed our expectations. With them, the trust and well-being of our animals are assured, and I couldn't be happier. I thank them from the bottom of my heart for everything they do for the well-being of my pets and others! Thank you 🙏

My dog looks and smells great after being picked up for her grooming appointment. The owner communicated well, arrived in a timely manner, sent updates, and was very open to feedback. My dog came home happy and relaxed, I can tell she was pampered and treated well.
Thank you so much 🙏🏽 …
My cat is very well taken care of. I trust Amor de Estimação's work 100%.

Our furry friend has been attending Amor de Estimação since 2022, both for daycare and as a family hotel, and we couldn't be happier.
We feel completely confident that he is well cared for and treated with love, as if he were family.
It's possible to follow his progress during the day in daycare or, if it's during the week in a family hotel setting, through videos and messages.
Whenever we take our furry friend, his enthusiasm is noticeable when he arrives, which makes us feel at ease and that we made the right choice.
He has also used their bathing service and always comes back spotless and smelling great.
Both Carolina and her mother, Maria José, are very kind people who help in every way possible and show a passion for what they do.
I highly recommend Amor de Estimação. ☺️

A year ago, we adopted our dog Kiko, who grew more than we imagined and also brought us some challenges. Since October 2024, he has been attending the Amor de Estimação daycare, which has been a very important help and has made a big difference in Kiko's upbringing. He receives a lot of affection, plays, socializes, and gets plenty of exercise with a very well-trained team that pays close attention to his development and behavior. The guidance and help they give us have been central to better educating Kiko and also seeking help with more individualized training. We now have a calmer, more balanced, and happier dog! When we have to use the hotel, we feel more at ease because we know he will feel comfortable with people he already knows well.

But perhaps the best compliment is Kiko's enthusiastic reaction when we tell him he's going to "school" 😅!

Impeccable service! Always attentive and professional service, with genuine care for our furry friends. The environment is welcoming and inspires confidence from the very first moment. The quality of the services is excellent — you can tell they work with passion and dedication. I recommend them 100%.
Thank you, aunts!

We've been clients for 2 years.
Our German Shepherd has been going to the dog daycare regularly for over 24 months.
In addition, we are clients of the hotel where we leave our dog whenever we travel.
Total trust, the dog is more than a client, she's a member of this incredible family.
I only have good things to say about the owners and I recommend them to everyone who, like me, demands excellent treatment for their dogs.
